C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 341
Date 24/5/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

May 23rd 1916.

Sir,
The six Japanese who were concerned in the attack
on the cruiser Tsu Dien were tried on the 16th instant
and ordered to leave China for three years. They
left for Japan on 20th instant by the s.s. Yamashiro Maru.
It is reported that an officer and ten
workmen employed in the Arsenal have been arrested
for secretly selling bombs to the rebels.
It is said that Tsoyin Chou has definitely
decided to resign.
Chen Chi Mei's coffin is still in No.11
Sing Ming Lee Rue Paul Beau.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Z.V. May 28
pages.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记
第 341 号
日期 16/5/24

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年5月23日。

先生：

参与袭击“筑殿”号巡洋舰的六名日本人已于本月16日受审，并被勒令三年内离开中国。他们已于本月20日乘坐“山城丸”轮船前往日本。

据报，兵工厂的一名军官和十名工人因秘密向叛军出售炸弹而被捕。

据悉，周自齐已决定辞职。

陈其美的灵柩仍停放在宝昌路11号新明里。

您忠实的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。

Z.V. 5月28日
